items.criterion: Implement CF-384: classify codex --check app_server and auth rows as notes where non-blocking, preserve genuine WARN exit 3, update specs and handbook M5-C3, and pass the stated tests.
items.detail: (a) Classification at the call site: scripts/harness/install-codex.sh:311-325 `report_auth()` now emits `note "auth — $HOME/.codex/auth.json exists (mode $mode) …"` when a host login exists and keeps `warn "auth" "no CF_API_KEY_FILE and no $HOME/.codex/auth.json …"` when neither surface exists; scripts/harness/install-codex.sh:349-360 `report_app_server()` emits `note "app_server — [experimental] app-server subcommand present …"` when present and keeps `bad "app_server" "no app-server subcommand …"` when absent. Both are reached from `--check` at install-codex.sh:410 (`report_app_server "$b"`) and :417 (`report_auth`). (b) WARN mechanism untouched: `git show --stat HEAD` lists only 4 files (install-codex.sh, specs/HARNESS.md, M5-harness.md, codex-install-test.sh) — scripts/lib.sh is not modified, so `warn()`/`verdict()` (lib.sh:8, lib.sh:24-30) still turn any WARN row into `<LABEL>: UNVERIFIED` exit 3 for every other adapter (e.g. install-claude-code.sh:381,393; install-opencode.sh:104 still call `warn`). (c) Specs: specs/HARNESS.md:64-90 adds "Which conditions are notes, and which are WARNs" with a decision table naming `app_server` (present → note, absent → FAIL) and `auth` (host login → note, neither → WARN) literally, plus the call-site rule. (d) Handbook M5-C3: docs/handbook/chapters/M5-harness.md:172 (M5-C3 row now cites the note-vs-WARN classification and arms B5/B5b), :183-197 ("Note versus `WARN` is part of this contract (CF-384)"), and :208 (section 7 verification row for `bash tests/harness/codex-install-test.sh --hermetic` arms B5/B5b). (e) Tests run fresh: `bash tests/harness/codex-install-test.sh --hermetic` → exit_code 0, decisive lines `PASS  B5 codex-warn-classification: --check on the installed pin with a host login ends 'CODEX: PASS' (exit 0); app_server and auth are printed as notes, 0 WARN rows`, `PASS  B5b codex-warn-classification: a genuine WARN (no credential surface) still ends 'CODEX: UNVERIFIED' (exit 3)`, and `codex installer test: 48 passed, 0 failed, 1 skipped` / `RESULT: PASS`. `bash -n scripts/harness/install-codex.sh && bash -n tests/harness/codex-install-test.sh` → `bash -n OK`. Note: the repo's guard test_command is `bash tests/selftest.sh`, which does not invoke codex-install-test.sh (grep for `codex-install-test` in tests/selftest.sh returns nothing); the stated test for this change is the standalone script, which I ran directly and it is green.
